scope.note: RVAs are offsets from 0x60000000; no Wii U address appears here.

rules.join: RVA -> row in symbols.csv (exact integer match); VA = 0x60000000 + RVA
rules.comparison: logical name = (class chain, member token, cv-qualifiers); parameter lists dropped; template arguments compared as flattened tokens
rules.KIND_DIFFERENT: codedx name is ctor / dtor / operator / vtable / typeinfo / template instantiation, i.e. not comparable token-for-token with our identifier form
rules.cosmetic: same class and member kind on both sides; only notation differs
rules.real: the two names claim different things about the same address (measured: cv-qualifier contradiction, or class mismatch)
rules.demangler_dependence: none -- buckets are computed from a structural parse of the mangling; the external demangler is used for the display strings in this report only, and rerunning with it disabled yields identical buckets

bucket_meaning.NO_FUNCTION: codedx names code, our table has data at that RVA
